author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Here’s a question no one has ever asked before:
Is my phone listening to me?

Our phones have microphones, live next to our wet mouths all day, and somehow know way too much about us. So I decided to investigate this completely original thought that has never once been Googled by anyone.

Right Jeff? We Googled it.

Watch the full video to find out if your phone is listening… or if the truth is somehow worse. https://youtu.be/M_6IRTSYHgc

#shorts #funny #comedy #dataprivacy #ryangeorge
